name: The MCAD Software sketch constraint settings

elements.name: constraint-settings-01 Commit the intended inference settings

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
Infer constraints and Persist constraints are checked
the user open Constraint Settings to Inference
the user clear Infer constraints and accept
the user reopen the Inference tab
Infer constraints is unchecked
Persist constraints is unchecked and disabled
the user enable Infer constraints
Persist constraints becomes available and remains unchecked
the user check Persist constraints and accept
both settings are restored
`fixtures/cad/constraint-settings/constraint-settings-line.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
a horizontal relation glyph is displayed on its line

elements.name: constraint-settings-03 Cancel changes to inference configuration

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
Infer constraints, Persist constraints and all nine inference types are checked
Parallel and perpendicular priority is selected
the user open Constraint Settings to Inference and click Clear All
all nine inference types are unchecked
the user click Select All and clear Infer constraints
Persist constraints, the checked inference types and bulk-selection buttons are disabled
the priority choices remain available
the user click Cancel and reopen Constraint Settings to Inference
Infer constraints, Persist constraints and all nine inference types are checked
Parallel and perpendicular priority remains selected

elements.name: constraint-settings-06 Cancel Relax Mode configuration changes

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
Relax Mode is disabled with twelve removal choices
Preserve dimensions with equation is checked and disabled
the user open Constraint Settings to Relax Mode and enable Relax Mode
the removal choices, bulk-selection buttons and equation-preservation option become available
the user click Clear All and wait for settled painting
all twelve removal choices are unchecked
the user click Select All
all twelve removal choices are checked
the user clear Preserve dimensions with equation
the twelve removal choices remain checked
the user click Cancel and reopen Constraint Settings to Relax Mode
Relax Mode is disabled and the original removal choices are restored
Preserve dimensions with equation is checked and disabled

elements.name: constraint-settings-07 Inspect restored settings through Application Options

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited and the Tools ribbon visible
the user open Application Options to Sketch and Constraint Settings
Edit dimension when created and Create dimensions from input values are checked
Warn of overconstrained condition is selected
the user choose Inference
Infer constraints and Persist constraints and all nine types are checked
Parallel and perpendicular priority is selected
the user choose Relax Mode
Enable Relax Mode is unchecked and its dependent controls are disabled
the user click Cancel and close Application Options
the sketch returns to Ready

elements.name: constraint-settings-08 Compare glyphs with inference disabled and enabled

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
Precise Input is active in Y-coordinate and X-axis-angle mode

elements.name: constraint-settings-09 Retain Relax Mode after accepting and restore it

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/constraint-settings/constraint-settings-line.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
Relax Mode is disabled with the recorded removal choices
Preserve dimensions with equation is checked
the user open Constraint Settings to Relax Mode, enable Relax Mode and accept
the user reopen Constraint Settings to Relax Mode
Enable Relax Mode remains checked
the user clear Enable Relax Mode and accept
the original disabled preference is restored

elements.name: constraint-settings-10 Inspect initial Relax Mode removal choices

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
Relax Mode is initially disabled
the user open Constraint Settings to Relax Mode and enable Relax Mode
Coincident, Tangent, Smooth(G2) and Symmetric are unchecked
Collinear, Concentric, Horizontal, Vertical, Parallel, Perpendicular, Equal and Fix are checked
Preserve dimensions with equation is checked
